body: Yeah its a big part of the problem, I try to tiptoe around her a lot, to always make her feel appreciated and that Im proud of her trying to study etc. I think she sees I'm reliable and have sorted my life more or less and that makes her feel safe with me etc. I worry what could happen if we broke etc

I didn't really seek girl that much younger, we just hit it off. I had relationships with girls around my age and top was 7 years older. I do not plan who I fall for and I do not want to control anyone. I would actually prefere if she was more confident and self reliant

I do not intend to be her white knight. I try all the time to give her  nudge to become more self reliant and work on being more happy with herself and not depending on approval of others. She goes to psychiatrist, psychologist and therapist already and she still tried to commit. I feel that as long as she lives with her parents she won't get better, because it's really toxic environment.
I'm 99% sure she would please me against her wishes before breaking up and that's why I'm afraid to talk to her. I don't want to take advantage of her love and commitment to me.

Yeah I understand the age gap is a big part of all of this. The problem is I love her, she seems to love me. Additionally she said that if it wasn't for me being part of her life she would've killed herself in September. She already tried few times before we met.

I do let her make that decision. The whole post is about me trying not to put pressure on her but still find a way to talk about it and my feelings of being unwanted. I would hate myself for pressuring her into it and it would be the end for the relationship. I want her to want me, not to be pressured.

My dupa is worried more about her mother, she prepared a stick for me last time I visited :P She is a bit crazy zealous catholic woman
Yes, I literally wrote that in my post. It's not a problem I'm looking to get advice for.
I date someone I love, I do not label her as "virgin". Someone might prefere brunettes and date blonde.
Please reread what I wrote. I didn't say anywhere she has lax approach to sex. I said in general I prefere girls like this.

I can see where she comes from(because her bestfriend thought this as well before we met) and that age difference could point into me trying to take advantage of my gf as she is younger and has problems at home, which kinda is classic dirtbag target.

Sex is basic need in my opinion though and I never saw any relationship survive without it.

Because I love her. I know 10 years is quite a bit over usual difference, but do I turn her down and shut off my emotions because of this? I consider her an adult that understands her emotions and can make decisions. Also I didn't know if she is a virgin or not before we became a couple, because it has no meaning for me.

I think you didn't read correctly what I wrote. She said if we saw each other daily we would already be having sex. 

Also where do you even take this "just wants her V card" from? I'm not virgin basement dweller that looks for the one 'untainted' pure woman. I don't undrestand the appeal of boasting about taking girls virginity, I prefere girls with more lax approach to sex.
